BiblicalUsage: The verb form of bribery is rare, and it shows the thing turned upside down. Jerusalem gave gifts to her lovers instead of receiving them, hiring the nations to come to her, while Job asks his friends whether he ever said, Give a reward for me of your substance.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe bribery corrupts both ways, whether you pay for favour or take payment for it.
